## Yukti Smash Karts 2024

21 Mar 2024 - 21 Mar 2024 |Organized by:Information Technology
“Smash Karts” is a fast-paced multiplayer game where players race against each other in colourful kart battles. They can pick up power-ups, weapons, and gadgets to use against opponents while navigating through different tracks filled with obstacles and surprises. The goal is to outsmart opponents to be the last kart standing or to complete various objectives, depending on the game mode. “Smash Karts” is a fast-paced multiplayer game where players race against each other in colourful kart battles. They can pick up power-ups, weapons, and gadgets to use against opponents while navigating through different tracks filled with obstacles and surprises. The goal is to outsmart opponents to be the last kart standing or to complete various objectives, depending on the game mode. It’s like Mario Kart but with a lot more smashing and chaos!

## Venue:

D-306, D Block, MGIT

## Event Guidelines:

- Smash Karts event platform: Smash Karts
- After submitting the Google form for participant registration for the event, Room ID will be provided.
- A room will be created  for every five participants .They compete with each other and the person with highest smashes will be receiving the prize.
- In case of squad , two squads each consisting of 4 members compete with each other and the squad with highest smashes grabs the prize.
